preconditions.description: The input string length is between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by a valid permutation string.
If 'YES', the permutation string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1][i] == stdin.strip()[j] for i, j in sorted(enumerate(sorted(stdin.strip())), key=lambda x: x[1])))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the permutation is a rearrangement of the input string's characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1][p-1] == stdout.strip().splitlines()[1][p*i-1] for p in primes_up_to(len(stdin)) for i in range(1, len(stdin)//p + 1)))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the permutation satisfies the condition that for every prime p ≤ |s| and every integer i from 1 to |s|/p, the character at position p equals the character at position p×i.
